title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People’s Court on Deepening Enforcement Reform and Improving the Long-term Mechanism for Resolving Difficulties in Enforcement — Outline of People’s Court Enforcement Work (2019–2023)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Deepening Enforcement Reform and Improving the Long-Term Mechanism for Resolving Enforcement Difficulties

——Outline of the People's Courts' Enforcement Work (2019–2023)

Fa Fa [2019] No. 16

The Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China clearly proposed to "effectively resolve enforcement difficulties" and "ensure that winning parties obtain their rights and interests in a timely manner in accordance with the law." To resolutely implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, in March 2016, the Supreme People's Court proposed at the Fourth Session of the 12th National People's Congress to "basically resolve enforcement difficulties within two to three years." From 2016 to 2018, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, courts nationwide carefully planned, worked hard, united efforts, and tackled difficulties. Enforcement work underwent historic changes and achieved leapfrog development. The phased goal of "basically resolving enforcement difficulties" was achieved on schedule. However, there is still a gap compared to the goal of "effectively resolving enforcement difficulties" put forward by the Party Central Committee and the expectations of the people. In some aspects and some regions, enforcement difficulties still exist and are even relatively prominent.

To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's new concepts, new ideas, and new strategies for comprehensively governing the country by law, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, consolidate the achievements of "basically resolving enforcement difficulties," establish and improve a long-term mechanism for enforcement work, further improve the level of enforcement work, and strive to move toward the goal of "effectively resolving enforcement difficulties," the Supreme People's Court has formulated the "Opinions on Deepening Enforcement Reform and Improving the Long-Term Mechanism for Resolving Enforcement Difficulties," which shall be implemented as the outline for the people's courts' enforcement work from 2019 to 2023.

I. General Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology

Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, closely focus on the overall layout of coordinating the "five-in-one" and promoting the "four comprehensive" strategic layout, adhere to the people-centered development philosophy, adhere to the general working tone of seeking progress while maintaining stability, implement the requirements for promoting the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity and promoting the construction of the social credit system, give full play to the political advantages and institutional advantages of socialism with Chinese characteristics, give full play to the mandatory characteristics of enforcement work, make full use of modern information technology, vigorously strengthen the standardization of enforcement, comprehensively enhance the credibility of enforcement, and promote the modernization of the enforcement work system and enforcement work capacity.

(2) Basic Principles

— Adhere to the correct political direction. Adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over the work of the people's courts, adhere to arming the mind, guiding practice, and promoting work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, enhance "four consciousness," strengthen "four self-confidence," achieve "two maintenance," unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, firmly rely on the Party's leading core role in overall planning and coordinating all parties, further develop and improve the enforcement system with Chinese characteristics, and promote the creation of a higher-level socialist judicial system.

— Adhere to a people-centered approach. Adhere to the mass line, firmly stand on the people's side, enhance feelings for the people, actively respond to the people's new requirements and new expectations for enforcement work, focus on solving the most prominent issues strongly reflected by the people, innovate working mechanisms for serving the people and resolving their concerns, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

— Adhere to serving the overall situation. Give full play to the enforcement functions of the people's courts, ensure that the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee are implemented strictly and thoroughly in the people's courts, provide high-quality judicial services for economic and social development, and provide strong guarantees for optimizing the business environment.

— Adhere to following the laws of enforcement. Follow both the general laws of judicial activities and the inherent laws of enforcement work, establish and improve supporting reform measures, duty guarantee mechanisms, and separate enforcement assessment mechanisms that are consistent with the operational laws of enforcement powers, ensuring that various work measures are realistic and can stand the test.

— Adhere to a problem-oriented approach. Enhance the targeting of work, increase efforts to solve prominent problems that affect the authority and credibility of enforcement and restrict the quality and efficiency of enforcement work, achieve practical results.

— Adhere to reform and innovation. Respect and protect the pioneering spirit at the grassroots level, encourage courts in various regions to actively practice and explore, continuously accumulate experience, timely promote and apply, and achieve positive interaction between grassroots exploration and top-level design.

— Adhere to "treating both symptoms and root causes." While addressing the current prominent issues in the enforcement field based on reality, adhere to strategic thinking and systematic thinking, establish and improve a long-term working mechanism, and comprehensively address enforcement difficulties from the source.

— Adhere to "one nature and two modernizations." "One nature and two modernizations" means highlighting the mandatory nature of enforcement work in accordance with the law, comprehensively promoting the informatization of enforcement work, and vigorously strengthening the standardization of enforcement work. It is necessary to accurately grasp the characteristic that the enforcement work of the people's courts is to realize the legitimate rights and interests of the parties through state coercive power, crack down on acts of evasion, resistance, and interference with enforcement in accordance with the law, forming a strong deterrent and high-pressure posture. Adhere to supporting modern enforcement models with modern information technology. Deepen the reform of the enforcement system and mechanism, improve the enforcement supervision and management system, standardize enforcement behavior, transform enforcement style, and enhance the credibility of enforcement.

(3) Overall Goals

Consolidate and deepen the achievements of "basically resolving enforcement difficulties," establish and improve a long-term mechanism for resolving enforcement difficulties, comprehensively improve the level of enforcement work, and strive to move toward the goal of "effectively resolving enforcement difficulties."

— Ensure a virtuous cycle of enforcement work and the normalized high-standard operation of the "3+1" core indicators.

— Ensure the normalized operation of the "top leader grasps it, grasp the top leader" working mechanism.

— Ensure the normalization of the enforcement work model supported by modern information technology.

— Ensure the normalization of serious rectification of non-standard enforcement behaviors such as passive enforcement, selective enforcement, and arbitrary enforcement.

— Ensure the normalization of the high-pressure posture against evasion of enforcement, resistance to enforcement, and interference with enforcement.

— Further promote the institutionalization and mechanization of the comprehensive governance pattern for enforcement difficulties, incorporate enforcement work into the overall framework of the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, and comprehensively address enforcement difficulties from the source.

— Further deepen the reform of the enforcement system and mechanism, improve the enforcement legal system and supporting systems, and gradually form mature and stable enforcement systems, mechanisms, and models with Chinese characteristics.

— Further promote the wide and in-depth application of modern information technology in the enforcement field, comprehensively enhance the level of informatization and intelligence of enforcement, and realize the modernization of enforcement management and supervision models, enforcement guarantee models, enforcement investigation and control models, and enforcement property realization models.

— Further transform the enforcement concept, strictly, fairly, and civilly enforce the law, pay more attention to enforcement methods and effects, effectively enhance the credibility of enforcement, and strive to achieve the organic unity of legal effects, political effects, and social effects of enforcement work.

— Further optimize the comprehensive application of various compulsory enforcement measures, strive to achieve efficient, precise, and detailed crackdowns on evasion of enforcement, resistance to enforcement, interference with enforcement, and punishment of dishonest acts, promote the construction of a social credit system, and significantly increase the proportion of parties who voluntarily perform effective legal documents.

— Further strengthen team building, enrich enforcement forces, optimize personnel structure, comprehensively enhance the "four modernizations" level of the enforcement team, and forge an enforcement iron army that is loyal to the Party, serves the people, has the courage to take responsibility, enforces the law impartially, and has strict discipline.

II. Main Tasks

(1) Improve the Overall Pattern of Comprehensive Governance for Enforcement Difficulties

1. Continuously deepen the comprehensive governance pattern for enforcement difficulties of "Party committee leadership, political and legal affairs committee coordination, people's congress supervision, government support, courts as the main body, departmental linkage, and social participation." Promote the introduction of local regulations and normative documents to make the comprehensive governance pattern for enforcement difficulties institutionalized, mechanized, long-lasting, and sustainable.

2. Strengthen the comprehensive governance assessment of enforcement work. Promote the inclusion of enforcement work as an important part of comprehensively governing the country by law in overall planning, and incorporate the resolution of enforcement difficulties into the indicator system of governing provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) by law in various regions. Effectively utilize the comprehensive governance (peace construction) assessment and evaluation system and the business environment evaluation system, and give full play to the functional role of enforcement work in peace construction and business environment construction.

3. Promote the mechanization of departmental collaboration and assistance in enforcement work. Implement the "co-construction, co-governance, and sharing" requirements proposed by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, with the Political and Legal Affairs Commission taking the lead in establishing and improving the joint meeting system with various collaborative and assistance departments, incorporating various enforcement linkage tasks into the scope of duties of each linkage department, clarifying tasks, consolidating responsibilities, and strengthening assessment. Promote the normalized operation of the enforcement linkage working mechanism, and effectively solve the problem of "linkage without action, action without strength."

4. Strengthen grid management of grassroots enforcement work. Give full play to the role of grassroots Party organizations, rely on grassroots comprehensive governance centers, incorporate assistance in enforcement work into the grid management content of grassroots social security comprehensive governance, integrate various resources, and establish working mechanisms for grassroots comprehensive governance grid personnel to assist in service of documents, locate parties, assist in investigating property leads, urge performance, resolve enforcement-related petitions, and carry out enforcement publicity. Promote the interconnection and interoperability of the comprehensive governance platform with the people's courts' enforcement command and case-handling platforms, and push enforcement information such as lists of dishonest persons subject to enforcement, lists of persons subject to consumption restrictions, and reward announcements to grassroots comprehensive governance grid personnel in real time. Establish mechanisms for education and training, supervision and assessment, incentive and guarantee for grassroots comprehensive governance grid personnel to assist in enforcement, and promote positive interaction between grassroots governance and the enforcement work of the people's courts.

(2) Promote Source Governance of Enforcement Difficulties

5. Improve the completeness, comprehensiveness, and accuracy of basic information in the social credit system. Seize historical opportunities, promote the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and completeness of market supervision management information, tax registration information, citizens' personal property information, population resource information, and financial investment information through forms such as consultation and joint meetings, consolidate the foundation of the social credit system, and solve the problem of inaccurate and incomplete information on enforcement property and persons subject to enforcement from the source, which leads to the ineffective functioning of the enforcement investigation and control system.

6. Actively participate in and promote the construction of a complete social credit system. Timely report various problems discovered in enforcement to the leading units and joint meetings of social credit system construction, promote the integration of social credit information resources, promote the integration of various systems for social credit punishment, form a social credit system and social credit evaluation system that are interconnected, complementary, orderly in layout, and clearly structured, and fundamentally solve the core difficulties of enforcement work.

7. Promote the enhancement of legal awareness, risk prevention awareness, and credit awareness of the whole society. In accordance with the work requirements of "whoever enforces the law shall popularize the law," strengthen the publicity and education of the rule of law in compulsory enforcement through forms such as full media live broadcasts, publication of typical cases, and screening of film and television works, enhance the initiative and consciousness of parties to voluntarily perform effective legal documents, promote the formation of a social atmosphere where "abiding by the law and keeping trust is glorious, while breaking the law and being dishonest is shameful," and gradually internalize law-abiding and trustworthiness into beliefs and habits. Cultivate risk awareness among market entities, help market entities fully understand and pay attention to preventing market risks, especially commercial traps. Help parties fully understand litigation risks and the risk of the person subject to enforcement losing the ability to perform, and guide parties to apply for preservation measures.

8. Strengthen the effective connection between enforcement procedures and the social security system and commercial insurance system. Establish and improve a cooperation mechanism between the people's courts and social security departments to resolve enforcement cases involving people's livelihood, and promote the inclusion of enforcement cases involving people's livelihood where the person subject to enforcement has lost the ability to perform into the social security system. Explore and expand the scope of application of commercial insurance, especially liability insurance, so that debts such as personal injury and property infringement can be compensated in a timely manner when the person subject to enforcement loses the ability to perform. Promote the establishment of an insurance system connected with compulsory enforcement procedures, conforming to legal provisions and market laws.

9. Increase judicial assistance. Actively broaden the sources of assistance funds, standardize assistance procedures and standards, simplify the approval process, effectively carry out the assistance work for parties in difficulty in enforcement cases, and orderly divert "cases where enforcement is impossible" in accordance with the law.

10. Improve the working mechanism for transferring enforcement to bankruptcy. Implement the relevant systems and measures of the Supreme People's Court on the transfer of enforcement to bankruptcy, strengthen the clearance of "zombie enterprises" in enforcement procedures, and fundamentally reduce the stock of enforcement cases. Further optimize and standardize the workflow of transferring enforcement to bankruptcy, improve the incentive and constraint mechanism for parties to apply or agree to transfer enforcement to bankruptcy, ensure that transfers and bankruptcies are done as needed, and ensure smooth channels and orderly operation. Focus on solving the problem of lack of bankruptcy costs in the process of transferring enforcement to bankruptcy, and promote the establishment of a special fund for clearing "zombie enterprises." Improve the assessment mechanism for handling cases of transferring enforcement to bankruptcy and hearing bankruptcy cases, and mobilize the enthusiasm of people's courts at all levels to promote the work of transferring enforcement to bankruptcy. Promote the design of simplified bankruptcy procedures and quickly hear cases "without property to break." Strengthen the connection between enforcement information systems and bankruptcy case hearing information systems, and promote the sharing of measures, resources, information resources, and property disposal resources.

11. Promote the improvement of the compulsory enforcement legal system and supporting systems. In accordance with the legislative plan, complete the research and drafting work of the Civil Compulsory Enforcement Law before the end of 2019. Cooperate with the relevant work of amending the Bankruptcy Law, promote the effective connection between enforcement procedures and bankruptcy procedures, and legalize effective experiences such as transferring enforcement to bankruptcy and simplified bankruptcy procedures. Carry out pilot work with functions equivalent to the personal bankruptcy system, laying a practical foundation for establishing a personal bankruptcy system. Cooperate with the amendment of the Company Law, curb acts of evading enforcement, such as transferring and concealing property, from the source by improving the corporate governance structure, financial management system, responsibilities of controlling shareholders and senior management, and the corporate personality denial system.

(3) Deeply Promote Reform of the Enforcement System

12. Promote reform of the enforcement management system of the people's courts. Rely on the enforcement command center to strengthen "three unifications" enforcement management, and explore the promotion of reform of the enforcement management system. Support courts in various regions, under the leadership of local Party committees and with the approval of the Supreme People's Court, in carrying out pilot reforms of the enforcement management system in conjunction with staffing and personnel management reforms. Pilot models include: first, the intermediate people's courts of cities (prefectures) exercise vertical leadership over the enforcement agencies of district (county) people's courts; second, the enforcement agencies of district (county) people's courts accept dual leadership from the local people's court and the intermediate people's court, with leadership from the superior enforcement agency in enforcement operations. The pilot work shall be completed by the end of 2020.

13. Accelerate the promotion of the reform of the separation of adjudication and enforcement. Divide enforcement powers into enforcement implementation powers and enforcement adjudication powers. People's courts with a high caseload and certain conditions may set up an enforcement adjudication division within the enforcement bureau or separately, which shall be responsible for handling enforcement objections, reconsiderations, and lawsuits concerning enforcement objections. For courts without such conditions, enforcement implementation work and adjudicative matters such as enforcement objections and reconsiderations shall be handled by different judge teams within the enforcement agency, and lawsuits concerning enforcement objections shall be handled by relevant adjudication divisions.

14. Establish a mechanism where cases adjudicated by dispatched tribunals of grassroots people's courts are enforced by those dispatched tribunals. Dispatched tribunals with sufficient staffing shall set up dedicated enforcement teams; those without sufficient conditions may designate relatively fixed personnel to be responsible for enforcement. The enforcement work of dispatched tribunals shall be uniformly managed by the enforcement agency of the grassroots people's court. Full-time or part-time personnel shall be included in the roster of enforcement personnel, and cases shall be included in the unified enforcement case management platform.

15. Fully implement the team case-handling model in enforcement. Implement a judge-led "judge + judge assistant (enforcement officer) + judicial police + clerk" team case-handling model, optimize the division of tasks and powers within and between teams, and improve the enforcement power operation model that is "classified personnel, centralized affairs, clear powers and responsibilities, and smooth coordination."

16. Promote the participation of judicial police in enforcement. In accordance with the principle of "organized management, dispatched for use," assign relatively fixed judicial police to the enforcement agency. The police unit shall manage them uniformly, and the enforcement agency shall dispatch and use them. The police unit and the enforcement agency shall jointly assess and train them. Judge assistants and clerks in the enforcement agency who meet the conditions may voluntarily become judicial police and be incorporated into the police unit. Grant judicial police enforcement authority that reflects the requirements of enforcement work in enforcement policing, and give full play to the role of judicial police in taking compulsory measures, cracking down on acts of resisting enforcement, and collecting evidence, thereby enhancing enforcement efficiency and deterrence.

17. Actively introduce professional forces to participate in enforcement. Establish and improve working mechanisms for deep participation of professional institutions and personnel such as arbitration, notarization, lawyers, accounting, and auditing in enforcement. Distinguish core matters and auxiliary matters of enforcement powers, establish a diversion mechanism for auxiliary matters, and explore the appropriate outsourcing of auxiliary matters in enforcement work, such as property investigation and control, online auction assistance, distribution of case funds, and service of documents, to professional social forces. Improve the working mechanism for the people's courts to purchase social services, ensuring that various actions such as open bidding, quality assessment, operation supervision, confidentiality agreements, and business training are legal and compliant, and that the outsourcing mechanism is fair and open.

(4) Improve Modern Enforcement Working Mechanisms

18. Improve the enforcement power operation mechanism of diversion of simple and complex cases and centralized handling of affairs. The enforcement command center shall conduct type-based processing of enforcement cases, achieving "quick enforcement of simple cases, refined enforcement of difficult cases." Strengthen centralized handling of routine matters, centralize the handling of routine work in enforcement procedures, such as property investigation and control, document production and service, management of cases where enforcement is terminated for this round, and enforcement-related petitions, by specialized teams to improve enforcement efficiency.

19. Improve the coordination mechanism for case filing, adjudication, and enforcement. Strengthen case filing review for enforcement. Courts with conditions may assign the case filing review for specific cases such as restoration of enforcement, enforcement of mediation documents, arbitration awards, notarized creditor's rights documents, and enforcement objections, reconsiderations, and supervision to the enforcement bureau, or establish a working mechanism for the enforcement bureau to participate in the case filing review of specific enforcement cases. Establish a system for prompting the risk of enforcement impossibility at the case filing stage, so that parties have reasonable expectations of litigation results and enforcement results. Strengthen case filing for preservation, promote preservation insurance guarantees and enforcement affairs center working mechanisms. Explore diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, with enforcement personnel participating in pre-litigation and during-litigation mediation to resolve disputes in one go and achieve case closure. Strengthen supervision and assessment of property preservation work to prevent abuse of preservation measures. Strictly implement the requirement that the enforcement content of judgments must be clear and specific. Before the end of 2019, people's courts at all levels shall issue regulations to make the enforceability of mediation and judgment content an important factor in assessing case quality and efficiency and work performance. Revise the style of judicial documents of the people's courts, clarify the period for applying for enforcement, the court accepting enforcement, and the consequences of the obligor's failure to perform obligations in the judicial documents. Formulate management regulations for the refund and recovery of litigation fees, and standardize the compulsory enforcement of litigation fees.

20. Improve the supervision, restoration, and withdrawal mechanism for cases without property available for enforcement. Further improve the criteria and procedures for concluding a case by terminating this round of enforcement procedures, and strengthen the supervision and assessment of such cases through informatization means. Establish a regular unified inspection and automatic reminder working mechanism for cases where enforcement is terminated for this round, and standardize the management of case restoration for enforcement. Improve the working mechanism for transferring cases where enforcement is terminated for this round to bankruptcy review, and standardize and promote the withdrawal of cases where enforcement is impossible from enforcement procedures.

21. Improve the working mechanism for enforcement of special cases. Implement classified management for special cases involving Party and government organs, the military, and people's livelihood, forming a normalized special enforcement mechanism. Improve the enforcement cooperation mechanism between military and local courts, properly handle enforcement cases involving both military and local parties, and provide a favorable legal environment for national defense and military construction. Improve the communication and coordination mechanism for enforcement cases involving Party and government organs, by regularly issuing joint notifications with the Party Committee Political and Legal Affairs Commission, supervising and interviewing, conducting joint credit punishment with the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments, implementing comprehensive governance assessment, and incorporating the settlement of government debts involved in litigation into budget management, so as to promote Party and government organs to take the lead in performing effective judgments. Establish a long-term mechanism for enforcement of cases involving people's livelihood, combining special enforcement activities during traditional festivals with daily working mechanisms, adhering to the principles of priority in case filing, priority in enforcement, and priority in distribution of enforcement funds, to protect the vital interests of the people. By the end of 2020, establish an enforcement information system for special cases involving Party and government organs, the military, and people's livelihood, realizing online inquiry, summary, and supervision functions.

22. Improve the cross-regional enforcement cooperation and coordinated enforcement mechanism. Strengthen the concept of a unified national enforcement chessboard, improve the national unified cooperative enforcement working mechanism based on entrustment of enforcement matters, establish a system for cross-regional enforcement to report to the higher-level court and the enforcement command center of the enforcement locality, effectively strengthen the case management responsibility of the higher-level court, and enhance assistance and guarantee for cross-regional enforcement. Establish a national court enforcement coordination case handling system, where all reporting, evidence exchange, follow-up tracking, supervision and implementation of coordination cases are handled through the system. Strengthen the intensity of coordinated enforcement work, and increase case management and work assessment efforts.

23. Improve the integrated enforcement working mechanism for civil, criminal, and administrative cases. While further improving the civil enforcement system, strengthen the construction of criminal property-related enforcement and administrative enforcement systems, improve relevant working mechanisms, and fill the shortcomings in criminal and administrative case enforcement. Improve the coordination and cooperation mechanism for case filing, adjudication, and enforcement of criminal property-related enforcement cases, and the connection mechanism between enforcement and commutation of sentence and parole, to enhance the intensity and standardization level of criminal property-related enforcement. Improve the management of property involved in criminal property-related enforcement cases, and improve the work procedures for custody, auction, sale, and surrender to the state treasury of involved property. Focus on strengthening and promoting the comprehensive enforcement of property penalties in corruption cases, strengthening the recovery and restitution of property in cases involving people's livelihood, and the enforcement of incidental civil action cases. Combined with the informatization construction of enforcement, further strengthen the informatization management and supervision of criminal property-related enforcement cases, and further standardize the scope, rules, and procedures of administrative enforcement cases.

(V) Deepening the transformation of enforcement models supported by modern information technology

24. Improve the "1+2+N" enforcement informatization system. Accelerate the construction of the enforcement informatization system, with the Enforcement Command Center Integrated Management Platform as the core, the unified case handling system and enforcement disclosure system of the four-level courts as two wings, and N enforcement case handling auxiliary systems such as online property inquiry and control, evaluation and auction, credit punishment, and entrustment of enforcement as subsystems. Strengthen system application, implement the "three unified" management requirements of enforcement work through informatization means. Vigorously promote document digitization and real-time generation of electronic case files, realize the intelligent reading and identification of enforcement information resources by the system, promote the automatic generation of legal documents and automatic backfilling of key nodes, providing intellectual support and auxiliary and transactional work support for judges. Further upgrade the enforcement case handling system, restrict enforcement power and standardize enforcement behavior through informatization means. Further optimize the enforcement inquiry and control, online evaluation, online auction, and credit punishment systems, providing information technology support for front-line police officers to take enforcement measures, improve enforcement efficiency, and increase enforcement intensity. Deploy the enforcement emergency system in accordance with laws and regulations, achieve full coverage of "dedicated network + internet" in enforcement management, and further improve management ability and level. Through APP, instant messaging, WeChat mini-programs and other technical means, strengthen risk warnings and node push, provide "one-stop" litigation services for parties, and promote extensive participation of parties and lawyers in enforcement. Explore the online handling of service of process, save service costs, and improve service efficiency. Increase the application and transformation of new technologies represented by blockchain technology in enforcement business, improve enforcement efficiency, and enhance the people's sense of gain.

25. Improve the unified enforcement case handling platform for the four-level courts. Fully upgrade the case process information management system within one to two years, optimize and strengthen the automatic backfilling and automatic control of key process nodes, and realize the entire online process, full trace, and all-round multi-level monitoring of the case handling process. Realize visual and standardized supervision of case nodes such as document sending, property inquiry and control, inquiry and evaluation, auction and sale, and distribution of case funds. Enhance system service functions, upgrade automatic early warning and reminder functions for enforcement nodes, enforcement deadlines, and pre-procedures, and improve the user experience of system operation. Strengthen the construction of mobile enforcement working system, timely transmit and store on-site enforcement data, pictures, videos, etc., push case information, realize effective connection between offline enforcement and online system, gradually realize mobile online office for enforcement work, and provide information system guarantee for enforcement police officers when going out for enforcement. Strengthen the overall management of detention of persons subject to enforcement and related data, realize network connection with public security organs, and fully grasp data such as detention location, detention days, detention times, and repeated detention.

26. Accelerate the substantive operation of the Enforcement Command Center. Strengthen the institutional construction of the Enforcement Command Center, formulate relevant norms before the end of 2019, clarify the functional positioning, operating mechanism, equipment standards, and operational guarantee of the enforcement command centers of various levels of courts, and provide clear basis for the construction of enforcement command centers. Give full play to the support and guarantee role of the Enforcement Command Center in team-based case handling, achieve intensive handling of transactional work, and standardization and normalization of work processes. Give full play to the command and dispatch function of the Enforcement Command Center, based on entrustment of matters, promote cross-regional and cross-departmental matter cooperation, accelerate the deployment of the enforcement command emergency response system, achieve full coverage of national courts as soon as possible, open up internal and external network connections, effectively solve the problem of enforcement information connection between the Enforcement Command Center and external enforcement personnel, and among external enforcement personnel, gradually form a new pattern of enforcement command and dispatch work covering the whole country, integrating upper and lower levels, linking internal and external, responding timely, and providing strong guarantee. Give full play to the central role of the Enforcement Command Center in enforcement management and enforcement assessment, achieve all-round management of enforcement cases, enforcement matters, and enforcement personnel, strengthen supervision mechanisms such as supervision and guidance to lower levels, and graded and time-phased supervision, gradually delegate various supervisory functions to the enforcement command centers of intermediate and grassroots people's courts. Strengthen duty and standby, gradually establish a 24-hour standby and emergency handling working mechanism with real-time linkage among people's courts at all levels.

27. Improve the People's Court online enforcement property inquiry and control system. Adhere to the construction idea of taking the national unified enforcement inquiry and control system as the mainstay and the enforcement inquiry and control systems of local people's courts at various levels as supplements. Further expand the coverage of the inquiry and control system, accelerate the comprehensive connection with internet finance, include various financial products such as insurance products into the inquiry and control system, realize online sealing up of real estate and special movable property such as vehicles and ships, fundamentally solve the problem of incomplete functions of inquiry, control, and seizure for some property forms, and realize the integration of inquiry, control, and seizure for all property forms. Promptly solve prominent problems such as poor operation of the inquiry and control system, untimely and inaccurate information feedback, and inconsistency between online and offline inquiries. Improve the intelligence level of the system, realize functions such as batch selection, automatic inquiry, round-the-clock inquiry, intelligent screening, and batch freezing. Use artificial intelligence to deeply mine feedback results, form a complete, concise, and convenient property control feedback list and property clue map, so that the enforcement judge can determine the direction and measures of property control. Under the premise of ensuring system security, promote the development of the inquiry and control system to the mobile terminal, facilitate police officers to use the inquiry and control system anytime and anywhere to serve case handling. Strengthen system application, regularly organize systematic operation training, strengthen supervision and guidance on the application of the inquiry and control system, and strengthen the awareness and ability of enforcement police officers to apply the inquiry and control system. Strictly standardize the retrieval and use of information, clarify authority, procedures, and responsibilities, keep full traces, prevent leakage of citizen and enterprise information, and ensure that inquiry and control operate within legal and compliant tracks.

28. Improve the dishonest punishment system. Through the national "Internet + supervision" system and the national credit information sharing platform, promote the sharing of information on dishonest persons subject to enforcement with public security, civil affairs, human resources and social security, natural resources, housing and urban-rural construction, transportation, culture and tourism, finance, financial supervision, taxation, market supervision, science and technology and other departments, as well as relevant people's organizations, social organizations, enterprises and institutions' public credit information. By the end of 2020, embed the list information of dishonest persons subject to enforcement into the "Internet + supervision" system and management and approval work systems of each joint punishment unit, realize automatic comparison, automatic supervision, and automatic punishment of the list information of dishonest persons subject to enforcement. Refine the graded credit punishment mechanism, apply corresponding punishment measures to different degrees of dishonest behavior according to the principle of proportionality. Smooth the relief channels for credit punishment, promptly correct problems such as erroneous inclusion, failure to remove in time, and inaccurate publication of information. Combined with the actual situation of enforcement work, explore the establishment of a credit reward for honest persons and a credit restoration system for dishonest persons subject to enforcement.

29. Build and fully implement the property evaluation system for enforcement. Launch the property evaluation system online in national courts in 2019. Fully implement relevant judicial interpretations to ensure the openness, transparency, and efficiency of the evaluation process. Formulate management measures for the list of online inquiry price platforms, establish a national list database of judicial online inquiry price platforms, accelerate the promotion of online inquiry price work, and gradually form a new model for people's courts to determine the reference price for property disposal. Formulate technical evaluation rules for entrusted evaluation, establish a scientific, reasonable, practical, and uniform standard technical evaluation working mechanism. Promote the connection of the inquiry price evaluation system with the national evaluation industry association system, realize industry self-discipline of entrusted evaluation institutions and online selection by parties, promote the use of targeted inquiry price evaluation systems, continuously improve the functions of targeted inquiry price evaluation systems, ensure that inquiry price evaluation work is carried out in accordance with law, standardized, precise, with full traces and full supervision.

30. Further strengthen the construction of the online judicial auction system. Implement the principle of priority for online auctions, expand the scope of use of online auctions, and improve the timeliness of property realization. Establish a provincial-level unified standard and unified management working mechanism for judicial auction auxiliary work, strengthen the standardization and normalized management of judicial auction auxiliary work. Improve supporting working mechanisms, effectively solve problems affecting property disposal efficiency such as vacation and delivery of auctioned property and elimination of vehicle violations. On the premise of not affecting the legitimate rights and interests of creditors, reduce the debt settlement costs of persons subject to enforcement as much as possible, accelerate the construction of systems such as the system for persons subject to enforcement to dispose of property by themselves within a specified period, the system for persons subject to enforcement to buy back auctioned property within a specific period, and the system for persons subject to enforcement to raise funds through the financing of sealed property to settle debts, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties in accordance with law.

31. Strengthen enforcement information security measures. Strictly implement network information grading protection and confidential protection technical measures, formulate corresponding work flows and systems, and ensure the security of the enforcement information system.

(VI) Improve the institutional system for regulating enforcement behavior

32. Improve the enforcement norm system. Comprehensively sort out judicial interpretations in the field of enforcement, complete the compilation and annotation of judicial interpretations in 2019, and solve problems such as complex levels, vague relationships, and content conflicts in the enforcement norm system. Timely formulate judicial interpretations to solve legal application issues in enforcement practice. Timely issue guiding opinions and normative documents to fill rule gaps and unify case handling standards in response to new situations and new problems in enforcement work. Do a good job in implementing the Civil Enforcement Law.

33. Improve the enforcement case supervision mechanism. By the end of 2019, issue regulations to clarify the handling process, time limit, and case closing standards for supervision enforcement cases, and improve the standardization level of handling supervision cases. Increase the intensity of handling supervision cases, establish work ledgers, assign special personnel, regularly report, establish a responsibility implementation and reporting feedback mechanism, and strengthen comprehensive governance assessment and enforcement performance assessment of supervision cases. Strengthen information management, incorporate supervision cases into the supervision case system of the enforcement command platform for unified handling, strengthen statistical analysis, improve handling efficiency, improve supervision and management effect, and prevent and resolve major risks related to enforcement.

34. Strengthen enforcement petition management. Strengthen the assessment of enforcement petition work, continue to take "the settlement rate of petition cases at 90% or above" as one of the core indicators for assessing enforcement work, and incorporate important indicators such as the settlement rate, resolution rate, case-to-petition ratio, and petition ratio to Beijing into quarterly and annual comprehensive governance assessment items and daily assessments. Strengthen the supervision of enforcement petition cases, adhere to substantive resolution as the goal, refine the standards for substantive resolution of enforcement petition cases. By the end of 2019, establish a ledger of enforcement petition cases with clear opinions from the higher court, and supervise to the end cases that have not implemented the clear opinions of the higher court. Optimize and upgrade the enforcement complaint and petition informatization management system, realize the interconnection and information sharing of the enforcement complaint and petition system with the enforcement case handling system, the online complaint platform, and the national court litigation petition system, give play to the supervisory role of the enforcement complaint and petition management system for upper and lower penetration and node control, strengthen system data analysis, and provide reference for enforcement work decision-making.

35. Strengthen the management of enforcement funds and property. By the end of 2019, accept the "one case, one account system" of national courts, improve the "one case, one account" working mechanism and informatization system, complete the connection of the fund and property management system or financial system with the case process information management system, realize functions such as short message notification of fund arrival and early warning of overdue undistributed funds, and fully realize the whole process and informatization of fund and property management. Establish a fund escrow working mechanism, clarify the escrow department and division of responsibilities, and strengthen centralized supervision of backlogged funds. Establish an enforcement fund and property management system, complete property identification online, establish a networked payment and receipt working mechanism, ensure convenient receipt and payment of enforcement funds, full trace, and timely distribution.

36. Severely rectify non-standard enforcement behavior. Give play to the role of the enforcement interview system, promptly initiate the enforcement interview procedure for problems such as passive enforcement, delayed enforcement, and illegal enforcement, and urge corrections within a time limit. Implement the system of accountability tracing and "dual investigation into one case", improve relevant mechanisms for transfer of problem clues, joint investigation, supervision and accountability, and incorporate the results of investigations into violations of discipline and law into comprehensive governance assessment.

37. Strengthen enforcement work assessment. By the end of 2019, people's courts at all levels shall revise enforcement assessment indicators, follow the laws of enforcement work, highlight the characteristics of enforcement work, and establish a separate enforcement work assessment mechanism different from trial work. Starting from 2020, enforcement cases and trial cases shall be counted separately and expressed separately in court work reports. Revise the implementation rules for comprehensive governance (peaceful construction) assessment and evaluation (court enforcement work part), incorporate the "3+1" core indicators and the implementation of enforcement supervision into the assessment scope, reasonably set points addition and subtraction items and scores, and explore the implementation of monthly summary, quarterly notification, and year-end deduction systems. Strengthen the application of assessment results, improve the working mechanism for enforcement agencies to cooperate with organization and personnel departments in assessing enforcement teams, and take the results of enforcement work assessment as an important aspect of cadre assessment.

(VII) Comprehensive application of compulsory enforcement measures to improve the authority and credibility of enforcement work

38. Increase the intensity of property investigation. Implement the property reporting system, increase punishment for non-reporting or false reporting, and enhance the deterrence of the system. For persons subject to enforcement who violate the property reporting system, or conceal property, property vouchers, accounting books, etc., resolutely take search measures. In areas not covered by the information system, adopt traditional investigation measures, strengthen investigation of the community and business premises where the person subject to enforcement is located. Explore the establishment of systems such as lawyers investigating the property of persons subject to enforcement, accelerate the promotion of systems such as entrusted audit investigation, notarial evidence collection, and reward for reporting, maximize the enrichment of investigation means and broaden channels for property discovery.

39. Severely punish acts of refusing to perform enforcement. Increase the punishment for acts of refusing to perform, apply compulsory measures such as fines, detention, and restriction of exit in accordance with law. Jointly with public security organs, quickly establish a networked operation mechanism for restriction of exit, jointly with public security organs and procuratorial organs, issue guiding opinions to solve prominent problems such as "difficulty in sending for judicial detention" and "difficulty in filing cases for the crime of refusing to perform a judgment", and establish a normalized working mechanism for handling cases of refusing to perform a judgment efficiently according to law. By 2021, improve the relevant legal systems for public prosecution and private prosecution cases of the crime of refusing to perform a judgment, and unify the standards for evidence adoption and legal application.

40. Resolutely crack down on acts of evading enforcement. Persistently carry out special rectification actions against evasion of enforcement, select key cases, adopt means such as internal and external linkage and upper and lower linkage to ascertain the facts, and punish in accordance with law by changing or adding persons subject to enforcement, taking compulsory measures, etc. Strengthen research on the abuse of objection rights and litigation rights, further clarify the punishment procedures and standards for abusing objection rights and litigation rights to delay or evade enforcement. Study the specific forms of transferring and concealing property by persons subject to enforcement, and improve systems such as property recovery in a targeted manner.

(VIII) Improve the open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine enforcement system

41. Improve the working mechanism for open enforcement. Implement the principles of active, lawful, comprehensive, timely, and substantive openness, adhere to "openness as the principle, non-openness as the exception", continuously expand the scope of enforcement openness, improve the form of openness, smooth the channels of openness, strengthen platform construction, and strengthen technical support. Deeply promote the standardization, normalization, and informatization of enforcement openness, accurately divide the standards for openness to parties and openness to the public, and clarify the responsible subjects for enforcement openness.

42. Expand the breadth and depth of enforcement openness. Seriously implement the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening Judicial Openness" (Fa Fa [2018] No. 20), promote the centralized and unified disclosure of enforcement case process information, information of persons subject to enforcement, list information of dishonest persons subject to enforcement, online judicial auction information, compulsory measures, property investigation and disposal measures, etc., on the same platform.

43. Encourage and support lawyers to participate in enforcement. In 2019, together with the Ministry of Justice and the All China Lawyers Association, issue opinions on lawyers' participation in enforcement, take multiple measures to increase the proportion of lawyers participating in enforcement, build information platforms to facilitate lawyers' participation in enforcement, and give full play to the role of lawyers in enforcement.

44. Build an intensive enforcement disclosure platform. Build the Enforcement Information Disclosure Website into an intensive enforcement disclosure platform, continue to ensure the platform's connection with the enforcement case management system, dishonest punishment system, consumption restriction system, inquiry price evaluation system, online auction platform, and case closure system within the court's dedicated network, and provide better "one-stop" enforcement information disclosure services to parties and the public. Enhance the interaction of the enforcement disclosure website, provide more convenient channels for parties to contact judges, improve the functions of providing enforcement leads and reward announcements, and mobilize all sectors of society to participate in, support, and supervise enforcement.

45. Innovate methods for disclosure of enforcement information. By the end of 2019, courts with the requisite conditions shall utilize mobile phone text messages, WeChat, litigation service hotlines, mobile phone applications, and other means to inform the parties of key stages in the enforcement process, meeting the needs of the public to access information on the enforcement work of the People's Courts through multiple channels. Accelerate the establishment of a rapid query information sharing mechanism with relevant departments, and push enforcement information such as case stages to the parties' mobile phones.

(9) Improve the enforcement supervision system

46. Proactively accept supervision by the People's Congress and democratic supervision by the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). Regularly report enforcement work to the People's Congress, earnestly listen to opinions and suggestions on enforcement work from People's Congress deputies and CPPCC members, jointly carry out law enforcement inspections, and regularly invite deputies and members to inspect, observe, and witness enforcement. Improve the working mechanism for handling suggestions and proposals, clarify responsibilities, strengthen supervision and urging, and ensure the quality and efficiency of handling suggestions and proposals. Strengthen the management of databases for responses to suggestions and proposals and related systems, realize online handling and tracking supervision of suggestions and proposals, connect the response database with the enforcement information disclosure platform, and disclose the handling situation to the public on a broader scale, enhancing the standardization, refinement, and informatization level of handling suggestions and proposals.

47. Accept procuratorial supervision according to law. Work together with the procuratorial authorities to improve the legal supervision system for enforcement activities in civil, criminal, and administrative cases, and handle procuratorial suggestions for enforcement supervision according to law. Establish a notification system for enforcement procuratorial supervision cases, incorporate enforcement procuratorial supervision cases into the enforcement case system, and strengthen daily management. Proactively invite procuratorial authorities to supervise enforcement cases with significant impact, group or sensitive enforcement cases, cases where the person subject to enforcement is a special subject or cases difficult to enforce due to external interference, and cases where the person subject to enforcement resists enforcement by violence or other means, so as to promote improvement of the enforcement environment.

48. Extensively accept social supervision. Promote the establishment of an "Enforcement Affairs Center" under the enforcement command center, and build a one-stop enforcement affairs service window. Smooth the communication channels between the People's Courts and the parties, invite representatives of the public to observe court enforcement work, conduct surveys and discussions, and fully protect the public's right to know, to participate, to express, and to supervise.

(10) Build an "Iron Army of Enforcement" for the New Era

49. Strengthen the revolutionary building of the enforcement team. Adhere to arming the mind, guiding practice, and promoting work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, adhere to taking the Party's political construction as the guide, educate and guide the vast number of enforcement cadres and police to enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds," ensuring the correct political direction of enforcement work. Strengthen the sense of mission, temper political responsibility, and help all enforcement cadres and police firmly establish a correct worldview, outlook on life, and values. In accordance with the requirements of the Party managing cadres, strengthen the building of the enforcement cadre team, earnestly implement the various decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, and take ideal and belief education as a strategic project for enforcement cadre work and persistently pursue it, forging a high-quality enforcement team that is reassuring to the Party Central Committee and satisfactory to the people.

50. Strengthen the regularization building of the enforcement team. Grasp the laws of the enforcement work of the People's Courts, conduct in-depth research on the functional positioning of enforcement work of People's Courts at all levels, distinguish the proportions of work such as management and case handling, and determine the staffing standards for enforcement personnel at different levels of courts. Strengthen the building of leadership teams of enforcement bureaus of People's Courts at all levels, earnestly implement the requirements of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Unified Management of Enforcement Work by High People's Courts" (Fa Fa [2000] No. 3). Before handling the appointment and removal procedures for the director of the enforcement bureau of a People's Court at any level, the consent of the court at the next higher level shall be obtained. If a higher court considers the director of the enforcement bureau of a lower court incompetent, it may recommend to the relevant department that the director be adjusted, transferred, or removed. Establish a system for directors of enforcement bureaus of lower courts to report and present work to the court at the next higher level, with the reporting results serving as an important basis for cadre assessment. Strictly implement the requirements for the proportion of enforcement cadres and police, strengthen the allocation of quota judges, judge assistants (enforcement officers), judicial police, and clerks according to work needs, prevent problems such as weak team strength, aging structure, and inability to meet the needs of enforcement development, and strengthen supervision and inspection of personnel allocation and guarantees.

51. Strengthen the professional building of the enforcement team. Strengthen professional training, leverage the resource advantages of the Enforcement College of the National Judges College, compile and publish enforcement training materials, carry out batch and category-based training and practical assessment of enforcement personnel, and strive to complete the full rotation training of all enforcement personnel nationwide within three years. Continue to run the "Enforcement Lecture Hall" well, focusing on newly issued enforcement normative documents, judicial interpretations, and hot and difficult issues in enforcement practice, and organize training and interpretation in a timely manner. Establish a hierarchical training and assessment working mechanism, clarify and implement the training responsibilities, tasks, and requirements of the four levels of courts. Give full play to the role of the enforcement professional committee, strengthen theoretical research and practical investigation, and improve the level of specialization. Explore the implementation of a system for two-way temporary assignment and training of enforcement personnel between higher and lower courts, promoting the growth of enforcement personnel's abilities in handling major cases, dealing with emergencies, and solving difficult problems. Strengthen the exchange of positions between enforcement departments and trial department judges. In principle, before being appointed as a quota judge, one must have one year of experience in enforcement implementation work.

52. Strengthen the professionalization building of the enforcement team. Establish and improve institutional norms for the professional qualification conditions, recruitment, promotion, and job transfer of enforcement implementation personnel, judicial police, and enforcement support personnel, optimize the composition of the enforcement team, and improve the quality of the enforcement team. Taking the deepening of comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system and the full implementation of the judicial accountability system as an opportunity, clarify the identity positioning and scope of authority of various types of enforcement personnel, and promote the management of separate job sequences for enforcement personnel. Innovate incentive mechanisms, establish a fault-tolerant and error-correcting mechanism for enforcement work, improve the mechanism for protecting enforcement cadres and police in performing their duties according to law, and punish acts such as false accusations, threats, and intimidation of enforcement cadres and police according to law. Improve the occupational security system for enforcement cadres and police, care about them politically, support them in work, and guarantee them in life, comprehensively care for enforcement cadres and police, improve pension and preferential treatment policies, implement mechanisms such as paid leave, compensatory leave and rotation, and psychological counseling, solve their worries, and enhance the professional honor, pride, and sense of belonging of enforcement cadres and police.

53. Strengthen the building of Party conduct and clean government of the enforcement team. Adhere to comprehensive and strict governance of the Party, unswervingly rectify work style and discipline, and unswervingly advance the fight against corruption. Coordinate the deepening of comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system with the building of Party conduct and clean government, improve the risk prevention and control system for clean government that is compatible with the enforcement power operation system, and ensure fair and clean enforcement. Improve judicial inspections, integrate supervision forces, and strengthen supervision for implementation. Strengthen regular rotation and exchange of key positions. Improve the interest avoidance system for job positions and powers, and regulate the contacts and interactions between enforcement staff and parties, lawyers, special interested parties, and intermediary organizations. Strictly investigate and deal with illegal and disciplinary acts in enforcement, and resolutely eliminate the bad apples in the enforcement team.

III. Organization and Implementation

(1) Strengthen organizational leadership

Relevant departments of the Supreme People's Court shall strengthen overall coordination, promote implementation, supervise implementation, and summarize and evaluate the tasks of this outline. By establishing ledgers, managing accounts, tracking supervision, and inspecting accountability, ensure that tasks are advanced with focus and steps. Strictly implement the working mechanism of "the top leader grasps it, and grasp the top leader," strengthen the main responsibility of the "top leader" of People's Courts at all levels, strengthen the decomposition of work tasks, and clarify the timetable, roadmap, and responsible person for each task item by item, ensuring that each task is watched and grasped by someone.

(2) Strengthen work guarantees

Strictly implement the "Standards for Professional Equipment for Enforcement Work of the People's Courts" (Fa Ban Fa [2018] No. 7), separately budget for vehicle guarantees for enforcement work, equip enforcement personnel with necessary enforcement equipment such as mobile office terminals, portable printers, and mobile phone signal jammers at enforcement sites, and strengthen financial guarantees for the deployment and installation of the People's Courts Enforcement Command Emergency Dispatch Service Platform in courts nationwide. Optimize the operation and maintenance service management system and personnel guarantees, improve the enforcement work equipment guarantee mechanism, and build a modern enforcement logistics guarantee system.

(3) Strengthen the building of enforcement institutions

Strictly implement the requirements of the central government on strengthening the building of enforcement institutions, actively seek support from local Party committees, and strengthen the allocation of enforcement forces. Reform plans for enforcement institutions of People's Courts at all levels shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court for review.

(4) Strengthen publicity on the rule of law for enforcement

Publicity work is an important part of enforcement work. Further raise awareness of the importance of enforcement publicity work, strengthen organizational leadership, improve the working mechanism, establish a joint meeting system for enforcement publicity, form a joint publicity force, strengthen assessment and guidance, and achieve an enforcement publicity work pattern where the four levels of courts are integrated and resonate in sync. Highlight publicity priorities, expand publicity methods, promote social understanding, respect, and assistance for enforcement, enhance awareness of the rule of law, and promote voluntary performance of legal obligations. Strengthen public opinion guidance, implement a system of assigning specific personnel to be responsible, strictly implement the "three simultaneous" principle, respond in a timely manner and guide effectively, and do a good job of explaining legal policies and dispelling doubts.
